protocol: Explicit two-stage experimental procedure, not a drop-in one-call prompt. Three independent four-candidate plans per original source; an external seeded uniform draw selects one candidate per plan before any content is reviewed. Expand only that candidate with the neutral-biography final-record recipe. No previous run or rejected draft is fed into later independent trials. All plans and selections are retained. The candidate distribution is model-defined, not population-calibrated.

variants.hypothesis: Separating proposal generation from selection may prevent the model from repeatedly choosing its own familiar default when asked to consider alternatives internally.
